paragraphs: AbbVie or "the company" refer to AbbVie Inc., or AbbVie Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries, as the context requires. AbbVie is a global, diversified research-based biopharmaceutical company positioned for success with a comprehensive product portfolio that has leadership positions across immunology, neuroscience, oncology and aesthetics. AbbVie uses its expertise, dedicated people and unique approach to innovation to develop and market advanced therapies that address some of the world's most complex and serious diseases. AbbVie was incorporated in Delaware on April 10, 2012. On January 1, 2013, AbbVie became an independent, publicly-traded company as a result of the distribution by Abbott Laboratories (Abbott) of 100% of the outstanding common stock of AbbVie to Abbott's shareholders.

AbbVie operates as a single global business segment dedicated to the research and development, manufacturing, commercialization and sale of innovative medicines and therapies. This operating structure enables the Chief Executive Officer, as Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM), to allocate resources and assess business performance on a global basis in order to achieve established long-term strategic goals. Consistent with this structure, a global research and development and supply chain organization is responsible for the discovery, development, manufacturing and supply of products. Commercial efforts that coordinate the marketing, sales and distribution of these products are organized by geographic region or therapeutic area. All of these activities are supported by a global corporate administrative staff. The determination of a single business segment is consistent with the consolidated financial information regularly reviewed by the CODM for purposes of assessing performance, allocating resources and planning and forecasting future periods. See Note 16, "Segment and Geographic Area Information" to the Consolidated Financial Statements included under Item 8, "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" and the sales information related to AbbVie's key products and geographies included under Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations."
AbbVie's portfolio of products includes a broad line of therapies that address some of the world's most complex and serious diseases.

Immunology products. AbbVie maintains an extensive immunology portfolio across rheumatology, dermatology and gastroenterology. AbbVie's immunology products address unmet needs for patients with autoimmune diseases. These products are:

Skyrizi. Skyrizi (risankizumab) is an interleukin-23 (IL-23) inhibitor that selectively blocks IL-23 by binding to its p19 subunit. It is a biologic therapy approved to treat the following autoimmune diseases in the United States, Canada and Mexico (collectively, North America), the European Union and Japan:
Plaque psoriasis (moderate to severe) North America, European Union, Japan Psoriatic arthritis
North America, European Union, Japan Crohn's disease (moderate to severe) North America, European Union, Japan
Ulcerative colitis (moderate to severe) North America, European Union, Japan

In psoriatic disease (plaque psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis), Skyrizi is administered as a quarterly subcutaneous injection following two induction doses. When administered for Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, Skyrizi is given as three induction doses via IV infusion, followed by subcutaneous injection via an on-body injector every eight weeks. Skyrizi is sold in numerous other markets worldwide.

Rinvoq. Rinvoq (upadacitinib) is an oral, once-daily selective and reversible JAK inhibitor that is approved to treat the following inflammatory diseases in North America, the European Union and Japan:
Rheumatoid arthritis (moderate to severe) North America, European Union, Japan Psoriatic arthritis North America, European Union, Japan
Ankylosing spondylitis North America, European Union, Japan Atopic dermatitis (moderate to severe) North America, European Union, Japan
Non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis North America, European Union, Japan Ulcerative colitis (moderate to severe) North America, European Union, Japan
Crohn's disease (moderate to severe) U.S., Canada, European Union, Japan Giant cell arteritis U.S., Canada, European Union, Japan

paragraphs: You should carefully consider the following risks and other information in this Form 10-K in evaluating AbbVie and AbbVie's common stock. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect AbbVie's results of operations, financial condition or cash flows. The risk factors generally have been separated into two groups: risks related to AbbVie's business and risks related to AbbVie's common stock. Based on the information currently known to it, AbbVie believes that the following information identifies the most significant risk factors affecting it in each of these categories of risks. However, the risks and uncertainties AbbVie faces are not limited to those set forth in the risk factors described below and may not be in order of importance or probability of occurrence. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to AbbVie or that AbbVie currently believes to be immaterial may also adversely affect its business. In addition, past financial performance may not be a reliable indicator of future performance and historical trends should not be used to anticipate results or trends in future periods.

If any of the following risks and uncertainties develops into actual events, these events could have a material adverse effect on AbbVie's business, results of operations, financial condition or cash flows. In such case, the trading price of AbbVie's common stock could decline.

The expiration or loss of patent protection and licenses, including the loss of exclusivity for any of our products and increased competition from generics and biosimilars, may adversely affect AbbVie's revenues and operating earnings.

AbbVie relies on patent, trademark and other intellectual property protection in the discovery, development, manufacturing and sale of its products. In particular, patent protection is, in the aggregate, important in AbbVie's marketing of pharmaceutical products in the United States and most major markets outside of the United States. Patents covering AbbVie products normally provide market exclusivity, which is important for the profitability of many of AbbVie's products.

As patents for certain of its products expire, AbbVie could face competition from lower priced generic or biosimilar products. The expiration or loss of patent protection for a product typically is followed promptly by substitutes that may significantly reduce sales for that product in a short amount of time. If AbbVie's competitive position is compromised because of generics, biosimilars or otherwise, it could have a material adverse effect on AbbVie's business and results of operations. In addition, proposals emerge from time to time for legislation to further encourage the early and rapid approval of generic drugs or biosimilars. Any such proposals that are enacted into law could increase the impact of generic or biosimilar competition.

Large pharmaceutical companies and generics manufacturers of pharmaceutical products continue to expand into the biotechnology field and form partnerships to pursue biosimilars. Companies have developed and are developing biosimilars that compete with AbbVie's biologic products. As competitors obtain marketing approval for biosimilars referencing AbbVie's biologic products, AbbVie's products may become subject to competition from such biosimilars, with the attendant competitive pressure and consequences. Expiration of or successful challenges to AbbVie's applicable patent rights could also trigger competition from other products, assuming any relevant exclusivity period has expired. As a result, AbbVie could face increased litigation and administrative proceedings with respect to the validity and/or scope of patents relating to its biologic products.

paragraphs: The following is a discussion and analysis of the financial condition of AbbVie Inc. (AbbVie or the company). This commentary should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying notes appearing in Item 8, "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data." This section of Form 10-K generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024.

AbbVie is a global, diversified research-based biopharmaceutical company positioned for success with a comprehensive product portfolio that has leadership positions across immunology, neuroscience, oncology and aesthetics. AbbVie uses its expertise, dedicated people and unique approach to innovation to develop and market advanced therapies that address some of the world's most complex and serious diseases.

On February 13, 2025, the board of directors of AbbVie unanimously elected Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Robert A. Michael to succeed Richard A. Gonzalez as Chairman of the board of directors, effective July 1, 2025, at which time Mr. Gonzalez retired from the board.

AbbVie's products are generally sold worldwide directly to wholesalers, distributors, government agencies, health care facilities, specialty pharmacies and independent retailers from AbbVie-owned distribution centers and public warehouses. Certain products (including aesthetic products and devices) are also sold directly to physicians and other licensed healthcare providers. In the United States, AbbVie distributes pharmaceutical products principally through independent wholesale distributors, with some sales directly to retailers, pharmacies, patients or other customers. Outside the United States, AbbVie sells products primarily to wholesalers or through distributors, and depending on the market, works through largely centralized national payers systems to agree on reimbursement terms. Certain products are co-marketed or co-promoted with other companies. AbbVie operates as a single global business segment.

AbbVie's mission is to discover and develop innovative medicines and products that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow while achieving top-tier financial performance through outstanding execution. AbbVie intends to execute its strategy and advance its mission in a number of ways, including: (i) maximizing the benefits of a diversified revenue base with multiple long-term growth drivers; (ii) leveraging AbbVie's commercial strength and international infrastructure across therapeutic areas, ensuring strong commercial execution of new product launches as well as continued investment in key on-market products; (iii) continuing to invest in and expand its pipeline in support of opportunities across our core areas of immunology, neuroscience, oncology and aesthetics as well as new sources of growth such as obesity; (iv) generating substantial operating cash flows to support investments in innovative research and development and returning cash to shareholders via a strong and growing dividend while maintaining a strong investment grade credit rating. In addition, AbbVie anticipates several regulatory submissions, approvals and data readouts from key clinical trials in the next 12 months.
AbbVie expects to achieve its strategic objectives through:
•Maximizing revenue growth of our key on-market products, including Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Vraylar, Botox Therapeutic, Ubrelvy, Qulipta, Vyalev, Venclexta, Elahere, Botox Cosmetic and Juvederm Collection.

•Advancing our research and development pipeline by delivering late-stage pipeline milestones, achieving key proof-of-concept objectives across therapeutic areas and continuing to invest in key on-market product indication expansion.
•Maximizing the value of key acquisitions as well as continuing to invest in external innovation.

•The favorable impact of pipeline products and indications recently approved or currently under regulatory review where approval is expected in 2026. These products are described in greater detail in the section labeled "Research and Development" included as part of this Item 7.

AbbVie's strategy has focused on delivering strong financial results, maximizing the benefits of a diversified revenue base, advancing and investing in its pipeline and returning value to shareholders while ensuring a strong, sustainable growth business over the long term. The company's financial performance in 2025 included delivering worldwide net revenues of $61.2 billion, operating earnings of $15.1 billion, diluted earnings per share of $2.36 and cash flows from operations of $19.0 billion. Worldwide net revenues increased by 9% on a reported and on a constant currency basis.

Financial results for 2025 also included the following costs: (i) $7.4 billion related to the amortization of intangible assets; (ii) $6.5 billion for the change in fair value of contingent consideration liabilities; (iii) $847 million related to intangible asset impairment; and (iv) $276 million of acquisition and integration expenses. Additionally, financial results reflected continued funding to support all stages of AbbVie's pipeline assets and continued investment in AbbVie's on-market brands.

Subsequent to December 31, 2025, AbbVie announced a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government to further advance access and affordability of AbbVie's products in the U.S. while protecting and investing in U.S. pharmaceutical innovation. AbbVie will provide low prices in Medicaid and expand affordable, direct-to-patient offerings. Additionally, AbbVie pledged $100 billion in U.S.-based research and development and capital investments, including manufacturing, over the next decade. Under this voluntary agreement, the U.S. government has agreed to provide AbbVie a three-year exemption from tariffs and future price mandates.

On July 4, 2025, the United States government signed into law the One Big Beautiful Bill Act of 2025 (2025 Act). Included within the 2025 Act are provisions that permanently extend certain expiring provisions of the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, modify the international tax framework to reduce the tax rate on certain foreign earned income, restore the tax treatment of expensing for domestic research and development costs and bonus depreciation, and allow for full expensing of qualified production property. In addition, the legislation contains multiple effective dates and transition elections, with certain provisions effective in 2025 and others implemented through 2027. The 2025 Act also includes certain new health care provisions related to the orphan drug exclusion of the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, and Medicaid, which have various effective dates. The new legislation had a favorable impact on cash tax payments in the current year.

paragraphs: AbbVie 或 "the company" 指 AbbVie Inc.，或 AbbVie Inc. 及其合併子公司，視情況而定。AbbVie 是一家全球性、多元化、以研究為基礎的生物科技製藥公司，擁有涵蓋免疫學、神經科學、腫瘤學及美容領域的領導產品組合，以應對複雜且嚴重的疾病。AbbVie 透過其專業知識、專注人才及獨特創新方法，開發並行銷先進治療方案，以解決世界一些最複雜且嚴重的疾病。AbbVie 於 2012 年 4 月 10 日在特拉華州註冊成立。2013 年 1 月 1 日，因 Abbott Laboratories (Abbott) 向其股東發放 100% 的 AbbVie 普通股，AbbVie 成為一家獨立、公開上市的公司。

AbbVie 作為一個單一全球業務分部運作，專注於創新藥物及治療方案的研究與開發、製造、商業化及銷售。此運作結構使首席執行官作為首席運營決策者 (CODM)，能在全球範圍內配置資源並評估業務表現，以達成既定的長期戰略目標。根據此結構，全球研究與開發及供應鏈組織負責產品的發現、開發、製造及供應。商業活動則根據地理區域或治療領域協調藥物的行銷、銷售及分銷。所有這些活動均由全球企業行政團隊支援。將業務分部定為單一業務分部，與 CODM 定期審閱的合併財務資訊一致，用以評估表現、配置資源及規劃與預測未來期間。請參閱附註 16，"段落及地理區域資訊"，載於第 8 項 "財務報表及補充資料" 所包含的合併財務報表，以及第 7 項 "管理層對財務狀況及營運結果之分析" 所包含的 AbbVie 關鍵產品及地理區域銷售資訊。
AbbVie 的產品組合包含一系列治療方案，用以應對世界一些最複雜且嚴重的疾病。
免疫學產品。AbbVie 在風濕病學、皮膚病學及消化系統病學領域擁有廣泛的免疫學產品組合。AbbVie 的免疫學產品針對自身免疫疾病的未滿足需求，這些產品為：
Skyrizi。Skyrizi (risankizumab) 是一種選擇性阻斷 IL-23 的 interleukin-23 (IL-23) 抑製劑，透過與 IL-23 的 p19 亞基結合來實現。它是一種生物製劑，已核准用於美國、加拿大及墨西哥（合稱為北美洲）、歐盟及日本治療以下自身免疫疾病：
銀屑病（中度至重度）北美洲、歐盟、日本 銀屑病性關節炎
北美洲、歐盟、日本 克羅恩病（中度至重度）北美洲、歐盟、日本
潰瘍性結腸炎（中度至重度）北美洲、歐盟、日本
在銀屑病（斑塊型銀屑病或銀屑病關節炎）中，Skyrizi 以每季一次皮下注射方式給藥，需先進行兩劑誘導劑量。當用於治療克羅恩病與潰瘍性結腸炎時，Skyrizi 以三劑誘導劑量經靜脈輸注給藥，隨後以每八週一次皮下注射方式透過體表注射器給藥。Skyrizi 在全球多個市場販售。
Rinvoq。Rinvoq（upadacitinib）為一種口服、每日一次、選擇性且可逆的 JAK 抑製劑，已核准用於治療以下炎症性疾病，於北美、歐盟與日本適用：
類風濕性關節炎（中度至重度）北美、歐盟、日本銀屑病關節炎北美、歐盟、日本
強直性脊椎炎北美、歐盟、日本過敏性皮膚炎（中度至重度）北美、歐盟、日本
非放射性軸向脊椎關節炎北美、歐盟、日本潰瘍性結腸炎（中度至重度）北美、歐盟、日本
克羅恩病（中度至重度）美國、加拿大、歐盟、日本巨細胞動脈炎美國、加拿大、歐盟、日本

paragraphs: 以下為對 AbbVie Inc. (AbbVie 或本公司) 財務狀況的討論與分析。此評論應與第 8 項「財務報表與補充資料」中出現的合併財務報表及附註一併閱讀。此 10-K 表單的此部分一般討論 2025 年與 2024 年的項目，以及 2025 年與 2024 年的年對年比較。未包含於此 10-K 表單中的 2023 年項目及 2024 年與 2023 年的年對年比較，可於本公司 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度的 10-K 表單第 II 項第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析」中找到。
AbbVie 是一家全球性、多元化、以研究為基礎的生物科技製藥公司，擁有涵蓋免疫學、神經科學、腫瘤學與美容領域的領導產品組合，具備成功發展的潛力。AbbVie 藉助其專業知識、專注人才與獨特創新方法，開發與行銷先進治療方案，以解決世界一些最複雜且嚴重的疾病。
2025 年 2 月 13 日，AbbVie 董事會一致選舉首席執行長 (CEO) Robert A. Michael 接任 Richard A. Gonzalez 為董事會主席，生效日期為 2025 年 7 月 1 日，此時 Mr. Gonzalez 從董事會退休。

AbbVie 的產品通常直接銷售至全球各地的經銷商、分銷商、政府機構、醫療機構、專門藥房及獨立零售商，透過 AbbVie 自有的分銷中心與公共倉庫。某些產品（包括美容產品與醫療器材）也直接銷售至醫師及其他經許可的醫療提供者。在美國，AbbVie 主要透過獨立的經銷商分銷藥品，部分銷售直接至零售商、藥房、患者或其他客戶。在美國以外的地區，AbbVie 主要銷售產品至經銷商或透過分銷商，並根據市場情況，透過主要集中的國家支付系統協商報銷條款。某些產品與其他公司共同行銷或共同推廣。AbbVie 作為一個單一的全球業務分部運作。

AbbVie 的使命是發現與開發創新藥物與產品，解決當前嚴重的健康問題，並應對未來的醫療挑戰，同時透過卓越的執行實現頂級的財務表現。AbbVie 意圖透過多種方式執行其戰略並推進其使命，包括：(i) 最大化多元收入來源的效益，並擁有多個長期增長動力；(ii) 藉助 AbbVie 的商業實力與國際基礎設施，跨治療領域確保新產品發佈的強勁商業執行，同時持續投資於關鍵市場產品；(iii) 繼續投資並擴展其產品管道，以支持在免疫學、神經科學、腫瘤學與美容等核心領域以及肥胖等新興增長來源的機會；(iv) 產生大量的營運現金流，以支持創新研究與開發的投資，並透過強大且成長中的股息回饋現金給股東，同時維持強勁的投資等級信用評級。此外，AbbVie 預期在未來 12 個月內進行多項監管提交、批准及關鍵臨牀試驗的數據結果。
AbbVie 預期透過以下方式達成其戰略目標：
• 最大化我們關鍵市場產品的收入成長，包括 Skyrizi、Rinvoq、Vraylar、Botox Therapeutic、Ubrelvy、Qulipta、Vyalev、Venclexta、Elahere、Botox Cosmetic 以及 Juvederm Collection。
• 推進我們的研究與開發產品管道，透過達成後期產品管道里程碑、在各治療領域實現關鍵概念驗證目標，並持續投資於關鍵市場產品的適應症擴張。
• 將關鍵收購的價值最大化，同時持續投資於外部創新。
• 管線產品及近期獲准或目前正在審查中、預期於2026年獲准的產品對營運的有利影響。這些產品在本節標籤為 "Research and Development" 的部分有更詳細說明，該部分為本項目第7項的一部分。
AbbVie 的策略著重於交付強勁的財務表現，最大化多元化營收來源的效益，推進並投資其管線，回饋股東價值，同時確保長期強而有力、可持續的成長業務。該公司的財務表現於2025年包括交付全球淨銷售額612億美元、營運獲利151億美元、稀釋每股盈餘2.36美元以及營運現金流190億美元。全球淨銷售額按報告基礎及按固定匯率基礎均成長9%。
2025年的財務結果也包含以下費用：(i) 74億美元與無形資產減損有關；(ii) 65億美元與或有考慮金負債的公允價值變動有關；(iii) 8.47億美元與無形資產減損有關；以及(iv) 2.76億美元的收購及整合費用。此外，財務結果反映持續資金支持AbbVie所有階段的管線資產，並持續投資於AbbVie的現有品牌。

2025年12月31日後，AbbVie宣佈與美國政府達成自願協議，以進一步促進美國市場對其產品的可及性與可負擔性，同時保護並投資美國的藥物創新。AbbVie將在醫療保險（Medicaid）提供低價，並擴展可負擔的、直接對患者提供的服務。此外，AbbVie承諾未來十年內在美國進行1000億美元的研究與發展及資本投資，包括製造。根據此自願協議，美國政府同意給予AbbVie三年的關稅豁免及未來價格管制的豁免。

2025年7月4日，美國政府簽署了《2025年一體大美法案》（2025 Act）。該法案包含若干條款，永久延長2017年稅務改革與就業法案（2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act）中即將到期的條款，修改國際稅務架構以降低特定海外所得的稅率，恢復對國內研究與發展成本的費用化稅務處理及加速折舊，並允許對合格生產資產進行全額費用化。此外，該法案包含多個生效日期及過渡選項，某些條款於2025年生效，其他則於2027年實施。2025年法案也包含與2022年通貨膨脹減緩法案（Inflation Reduction Act of 2022）中的罕見病藥物豁免及醫療保險相關的新醫療保健條款，這些條款具有不同的生效日期。新立法對當前年度的現金稅款支付產生有利影響。

headings: 與 AbbVie 事業相關的風險
AbbVie 的主要產品可能早於預期失去專利保護，這可能會對 AbbVie 的營業收入與營運獲利產生不利影響。
第三方的智慧財產權可能阻止 AbbVie 銷售其產品，或對 AbbVie 的獲利能力與財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
AbbVie 的研究與開發工作可能無法成功開發出可成功商業化的產品與技術，這可能會導致其營業收入與獲利能力下降。
藥品福利管理機構及其他供應鏈中介機構對產品的價格與患者使用產品的權限有重大影響，這可能會對 AbbVie 的營業收入與營運結果產生不利影響。
AbbVie 短期內的藥物研發管道部分依賴與第三方的合作，這可能會對其產品的開發與銷售產生不利影響。
生物製劑具有獨特的風險與不確定性，這可能會對 AbbVie 的業務與營運結果產生負面影響。
貿易限制、關稅及其他全球貿易政策的變更可能提高成本、幹擾供應鏈，並對 AbbVie 的業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
AbbVie 的競爭對手可能推出新產品及技術進步，可能對 AbbVie 的營運成果產生負面影響。
AbbVie 的某些業務方面高度依賴第三方服務供應商。
AbbVie 的產品可能出現重大安全性或有效性問題，這可能會對 AbbVie 的營收及財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
AbbVie 面臨產品責任索償及其他訴訟，這些可能對其業務、營運成果及聲譽產生不利影響。
AbbVie 面臨政府規範，遵守這些規範及開發符合規範的產品與流程可能成本高昂。
影響政府福利計畫的法律及規範可能對 AbbVie 增加新的義務，要求其改變業務作法，並限制其營運。
AbbVie 事業的國際性使其面臨額外的業務風險，這些風險可能導致其營收及獲利下降。
若 AbbVie 未能有效地且獲利地推廣其產品，將可能對其營業收入與財務狀況造成不利影響。
AbbVie 可能取得其他企業、授權技術或產品之權利、建立合作關係，或處置資產，這可能會導致其產生重大費用，並對獲利能力造成負面影響。
AbbVie 有債務義務，這可能會對其業務及其履行義務的能力造成不利影響。
AbbVie 未來可能需要額外資金以應付其資本需求或進行機械性收購，而此種資金可能無法以有利條件取得，甚至可能無法取得。
若無法吸引、培養及留住高素質人才，將可能影響 AbbVie 成功開發與推廣產品的能力。
第三方非法分銷與銷售 AbbVie 產品的仿冒或未註冊版本，可能會對其聲譽、業務與營運成果造成重大不利影響。
其他因素可能對 AbbVie 的獲利能力與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
與 AbbVie 普通股相關的風險
AbbVie 無法保證其普通股股息發放的時間、金額或支付，亦無法保證其普通股的買回計畫。
AbbVie 股東未來可能因發行新股而使其持股比例被稀釋。
paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱本 Form 10-K 中所列之風險及其他資訊，以評估 AbbVie 及其普通股。任何下列風險都可能對 AbbVie 的營運結果、財務狀況或現金流產生重大且不利的影響。風險因素通常被分為兩組：與 AbbVie 事業相關的風險，以及與 AbbVie 普通股相關的風險。根據目前 AbbVie 所知的資訊，AbbVie 認為下列資訊可識別影響其在這些風險類別中最重要的風險因素。然而，AbbVie 面臨的風險與不確定性並不限於下列風險因素，且這些風險因素可能並非按重要性或發生機率排序。此外，目前 AbbVie 未知或認為不重要之其他風險與不確定性，也可能對其業務產生不利影響。另外，過去的財務表現可能無法作為未來表現的可靠指標，歷史趨勢也不應用來預測未來期間的結果或趨勢。
若任何下列風險與不確定性發展為實際事件，這些事件可能對 AbbVie 的業務、營運結果、財務狀況或現金流產生重大不利影響。在此情況下，AbbVie 普通股的交易價格可能下跌。
專利保護或授權到期或喪失，包括任何產品喪失獨佔權，以及來自仿製藥與生物相似藥的競爭增加，可能對 AbbVie 的收入與營運獲利產生不利影響。
AbbVie 依賴專利、商標及其他智慧財產權保護，用以發現、開發、製造與銷售其產品。特別是，專利保護在整體上對 AbbVie 在美國以及大多數主要市場外的市場推廣藥物產品至關重要。專利覆蓋 AbbVie 產品通常提供市場獨佔權，這對許多 AbbVie 產品的獲利至關重要。

當某些產品的專利到期時，AbbVie 可能面臨來自價格較低的仿製藥或生物相似藥的競爭。產品專利保護到期或喪失後，通常會迅速出現替代品，可能在短時間內大幅減少該產品的銷售。若因仿製藥、生物相似藥或其他因素而使 AbbVie 的競爭地位受到損害，可能對 AbbVie 的業務與營運結果產生重大不利影響。此外，時而會有立法提案鼓勵加速批准仿製藥或生物相似藥。任何這些提案若成為法律，都可能增加仿製藥或生物相似藥的競爭影響。

大型製藥公司與製造仿製藥的製藥產品廠商持續擴張至生物科技領域，並組建合作夥伴關係以追求生物相似藥。公司已開發並正在開發與 AbbVie 生物製品競爭的生物相似藥。當競爭對手獲得引用 AbbVie 生物製品的生物相似藥上市許可時，AbbVie 的產品可能面臨來自這些生物相似藥的競爭，伴隨競爭壓力與後果。專利權的到期或成功挑戰，也可能引發來自其他產品的競爭，假設任何相關獨佔期已屆滿。因此，AbbVie 可能面臨針對其生物製品專利有效性與/或範圍的訴訟與行政程序增加。
